map.通过抽样测试或已知的认识比例，估算您的英语词汇量范围。: Estimate the range of your English vocabulary through a sampling test or a known recognition rate.
map.词汇量估算 = f(测试正确率, 词表): Vocabulary estimate = f(test accuracy, word list)
map.下面列出 20 个不同难度的英语单词，请勾选您认识的单词，工具将根据抽样结果估算: Below are 20 English words of varying difficulty. Tick the ones you recognize and the tool will estimate your vocabulary size from the sampling result.
map.抽样测试为娱乐性估算，非专业测评工具。: The sampling test is an entertainment estimate, not a professional assessment tool.
map.如实勾选认识的单词会提高估算准确性。: Ticking the words you truly know improves the accuracy of the estimate.
map.📚 深度解析：英语词汇量估算（抽样统计）: 📚 Deep dive: English Vocabulary Size Estimate (sampling statistics)
map.用 20 个分层抽样词勾选认识比例，估总词汇量区间: Tick the recognized share of 20 stratified sample words to estimate the total vocabulary range
map.自测水平后制定背词计划（如目标 5000/8000）: Set a memorization plan after self-testing (for example a target of 5000/8000)
map.对比不同词表（通用/雅思/托福）看覆盖差距: Compare different word lists (general/IELTS/TOEFL) to see the coverage gap
map.抽样 20 词认得 14 个（70%），若参考词表 2 万词 → 估认识 ≈ 1: Knowing 14 of 20 sampled words (70%) against a 20000-word reference list gives an estimated vocabulary of about 14000; a common concise dictionary covers 80% of text with about 3000 core words, so knowing 70% of the sample already exceeds the basic threshold.
map.抽样有随机误差，结果给区间而非定值；认 16/20(80%) 与 14/20(7: Sampling has random error, so the result is a range rather than a fixed value; knowing 16/20 (80%) and 14/20 (70%) differ by 10 percentage points but the totals may differ by 2000 words, which is normal fluctuation.
map.抽样为什么用 20 词？: Why does the sampling use 20 words?
map.太少误差大、太多费时；20 词在可信度与效率间平衡，按难度分层（高频→低频）取样: Too few gives large error and too many wastes time; 20 words balance reliability and efficiency, and sampling stratified by difficulty (high frequency to low frequency) is more accurate.
map.估算能当真实词汇量吗？: Can the estimate serve as my real vocabulary size?
map.只能估被动词汇量（见词识义），主动复用（说写）通常更小；且认词标准松紧影响结果，: It only estimates passive vocabulary (recognizing a word's meaning); active reuse (speaking and writing) is usually smaller. Since how strictly you judge "known" also affects the result, treat it as a reference rather than an exact number.
map.词汇量是衡量英语能力的重要指标之一。本工具通过抽样测试或认识比例，给出一个粗略的: Vocabulary size is one important indicator of English ability. This tool gives a rough vocabulary range and a matching level reference through a sampling test or a recognition rate.
map.操作简单，即时反馈: Simple to operate with instant feedback
